name: test-layout-relocation
body: Sibling tests: each source module carries `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` pointing at `src/<module>/tests.rs`, which keeps the module path (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.e2e`) so the tier filters and graph queries resolve. Top-level e2e: one integration crate per source module (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, `tests/plan_cmd_e2e.rs`, `tests/git_e2e.rs`, …) shares `tests/common/mod.rs`; each e2e test carries `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …; run via cargo test-e2e"]`. White-box dependency: 268 of 310 e2e tests call crate-internal functions, and `testutil` is part of the library surface (or the shared `common` harness) so the integration crates compile. This component's `implemented-by` targets are the existing modules `rust.apg` and `rust.apg.testutil`; `src/lib.rs` and `tests/**` are the planned file nodes that re-home them.
